JUMBO ECO BOX – B Eco-Friendly Gift Set | BG1251

The JUMBO ECO BOX – B Eco-Friendly Gift Set | BG1251 is a premium sustainable gifting solution designed for businesses, events, and individuals who value impactful, earth-positive choices. This thoughtfully curated eco-friendly gift set includes plantable stationery, biodegradable accessories, and reusable items crafted to reduce environmental impact. Ideal for corporate eco gifts, employee onboarding kits, festive gifting, brand promotions, and environment-focused campaigns, this eco-conscious set merges utility with sustainability.

Each item in the eco-friendly gift set is made using recycled, biodegradable, or plantable materials, making it a perfect choice for brands that want to lead with responsibility. With rising demand for sustainable gifts and eco-friendly promotional products, the JUMBO ECO BOX – B stands out as a high-value, meaningful, and environmentally aligned choice.

What’s Inside the JUMBO ECO BOX – B (BG1251)

This sustainable gift hamper includes a wide range of functional and eco-conscious products designed to encourage green habits and reduce plastic use. The inclusion of plantable stationery, reusable items, and natural materials makes this one of the most comprehensive eco-friendly corporate gifting sets available.

  • 5 Plantable Seed Pencils Set – Premium pencils made from recycled paper embedded with seeds. Once used, they can be planted to grow herbs or flowers.
  • 5 Plantable Paper Pen Set – Eco paper pens infused with seeds, replacing plastic pens with sustainable alternatives.
  • Plantable Notepad B6 (Pin) – A compact seed paper notepad ideal for daily notes, reminders, and eco-friendly office use.
  • Mini Plantable Calendar (MDF) – A reusable wooden stand with seed paper month sheets that can be planted after use.
  • Forest Dweller Pen Stand + Eco-Click Pen – A rustic, wooden pen holder inspired by nature, paired with an eco-friendly click pen.
  • Ceramic Forest Bowl – A handcrafted ceramic bowl perfect for décor, storage, or table aesthetics.
  • Planting Kit – Includes a 4” pot and coco peat, enabling easy planting of all seed stationery items.
  • Seed Paper Card (5”x7”) – Customizable eco card made of seed paper, suitable for corporate messages, branding, or greetings.
  • Eco Box (10”x11”x3.5”) – A premium craft-based packaging box that completes this sustainable hamper.

Why Choose This Eco-Friendly Gift Set?

The JUMBO ECO BOX – B Eco-Friendly Gift Set is designed for brands that want to move beyond traditional gifting and embrace meaningful, low-waste options. Each element supports green living, encourages planting, and reduces landfill waste. Whether you’re searching for plantable stationery gift sets, sustainable corporate gifts, or eco-friendly employee welcome kits, this hamper offers unmatched value.

This gift set aligns with CSR initiatives, environmental campaigns, Earth Day celebrations, educational institutions, and businesses adopting eco-conscious policies. With eco-gifting becoming a top trend across India, choosing a responsibly curated gift box significantly enhances brand reputation and customer perception.

Key Features at a Glance

  • Complete eco-friendly gift set crafted from plantable, biodegradable, and reusable materials.
  • Perfect for corporate gifting, employee kits, festive hampers, and promotional giveaways.
  • Supports sustainability goals, environment-friendly initiatives, and CSR activities.
  • Premium-quality items that are both functional and environmentally safe.
  • Custom branding options available for bulk corporate orders.

Ideal For

  • Employee welcome kits and onboarding hampers
  • Eco-friendly festival gifting
  • Environmental awareness campaigns
  • School and college eco programs
  • Earth Day, World Environment Day & sustainability events

Choose the JUMBO ECO BOX – B Eco-Friendly Gift Set | BG1251 to deliver a powerful message of sustainability while offering practical and meaningful gifts. This eco gift set is a premium choice for organizations looking to reduce carbon footprint and make a positive environmental impact through every gifting gesture.
